chapter: Adolescence: A Stage of Growth and Change
subject: Science

topics.title: Introduction to Adolescence
topics.summary: Adolescence is the transitional stage between childhood and adulthood (ages 10-19 per WHO), marked by physical, emotional, and social changes.

topics.title: Puberty & Pubertal Changes
topics.summary: Puberty is when adolescents attain sexual maturity (9-12 in girls, 10-14 in boys). Changes include height increase, body shape changes, voice changes, hair growth, and gland activity.

topics.title: Reproductive Changes & Menstrual Cycle
topics.summary: The menstrual cycle is a 28-30 day cycle with 4 phases: Menstrual, Proliferative, Ovulatory, and Secretory. Menarche is the first period; menopause is the end of menstruation.

topics.title: Emotional & Behavioural Changes
topics.summary: Adolescence brings stronger emotions, mood swings, desire for independence, intellectual development, and social changes.

topics.title: Nutrition & Healthy Eating
topics.summary: A balanced diet with adequate proteins, carbs, fats, vitamins and minerals is crucial during adolescence. Iron and B12 deficiency can cause anaemia.

topics.title: Personal Hygiene & Exercise
topics.summary: Maintaining cleanliness, menstrual hygiene, regular exercise, and balanced social life are essential during adolescence.

topics.title: Saying No to Harmful Substances
topics.summary: Adolescents must avoid harmful substances like tobacco, alcohol, and drugs. The National De-addiction Helpline is 14446.

topics.title: The Role of Hormones
topics.summary: Hormones are chemical substances that regulate growth and development. Testosterone (testes), Estrogen and Progesterone (ovaries) are the key sex hormones.
